textes.(Agathe se penche sur la boule. La brume: (Agathe leans over the ball. The mist swirls, turns blue, then purple.)
textes.(Avec une lame, ça ne compte pas pour le: (With a blade, it doesn't count toward the title of Brawl King.)
textes.(Boulon remue sa queue en ressort, qui f: (Boulon wags his spring tail, which goes “boing, boing”.)
textes.(Brutus prend les dents, les frappe sur: (Brutus takes the teeth and strikes them on the anvil: they ring like iron.) Good teeth. (He heats, hammers, quenches, hammers again. The forge roars. An hour later…) There. An iron fist. In a brawl, your blows will count for more. But with fists only: a blade is for cowards.
textes.(Crochet reste longtemps silencieux. Pui: (Crochet stays silent for a long time. Then he rests his hook on your shoulder, very gently.) … Thank you. Here. Two gold coins. I was saving them for the day I'd killed him myself. That day will never come now. And that's just fine.
textes.(Elle chuchote.) Chut… Les petits font l: (She whispers.) Shh… The little ones are napping. They danced around the ribbon tree all morning. Would you help me tuck them in? Gently…
textes.(Elle chuchote.) Ô Grand Spaghetti, fais: (She whispers.) O Great Spaghetti, make sure my pasta never sticks. Ramen.
textes.(Elle déroule les plans sur ses genoux,: (She unrolls the plans across her lap, very slowly. Four hundred shops. Two thousand parking spaces. A fountain that plays an anthem.) ... Is that all? That's what he wanted to put in place of our lives? (She rolls up the plans.) Well. We'll keep them. We'll hang them in the assembly hall, so we remember. And look who's coming. (Mister Lisse is there, his tie crooked, his tablet switched off under his arm. He says nothing. Then he takes out a pen. Mamie hands him a paper. He signs. His hands tremble a little.) The Port-Boucan Shared Lease. The premises belong to those who bring them to life. Signed Aldric Lisse. (She smiles.) Here, Aldric. A toffee. It's been a while.
(She opens it with a bone paper knife.) A book that's been overdue for three hundred and twelve years. I knew I'd find it again. Thank you.
textes.(Elle les prend un par un. Ils grésillen: (She takes them one by one. They crackle, they sing, and for once, her hair stays flat.) Bzzzz… Do you hear that? They're singing. I'll mount them on my staff. (A little spark shoots straight ahead, and hits… the wall. Not her.) Oh. OH. Did you see? Forwards!
textes.(Elle les regarde un par un, en souriant: (She looks at them one by one, smiling.) The Spring Bolete: you'll jump three times higher. The Moonwort: you'll see what's hidden. The Chatterer: you'll understand animals, and believe me, they have a lot to say. The Rainbow: the world will dance with colours and your feet will go faster. The Little Giant: you'll grow for a while, and be stronger. Keep them: they're yours. You can eat them from your bag, here, in our tale. And in the real forest? ... Never! Good. You remembered. Here, for the road, two more Spring Boletes.
textes.(Elle siffle deux notes et s'essuie les: (She whistles two notes and wipes her hands. It changes nothing.) Welcome! A friend of Rouille's is a friend of mine. If one day you have a squeaky bike, a bent wheel or a chain that skips, come to the workshop. I won't fix it for you: I'll teach you how to fix it. It's better. And it takes longer. But it's better.
textes.(Elle siffle trois notes joyeuses, ouvre: (She whistles three cheerful notes, opens the bags, and pulls out a chain, pedals, spokes, a bell shaped like a rat.) A rat-shaped bell! Ferraille, you're a genius! (She already has her hands in the grease.) With this, I'll put ten bikes back on the road. And the eleventh, I'll keep for you. Well, if you know how to fix a flat. No? I'll teach you.
textes.(Elle siffle une note très longue et trè: (She whistles one very long, very low note.) Upset? I've got fourteen bikes to fix and not a single part left! No more chains, no more pedals, no more spokes! Lisse's robots ransacked the Scrapyard and took everything to make themselves arms. But Ferraille told me he hid three lots of parts under his scrap piles, just for me. Would you go get them? It's at the Scrapyard, to the south-east. If you run into Ferraille, don't ask him about his dragon: you'd be there all day.
textes.(F : garde · Ctrl : roulade · éloigne-to: (F: guard · Ctrl: roll · move away to flee)
textes.(Il branche un petit câble violet sur to: (He plugs a little purple cable into your travel journal.) And… there! Installing. Don't worry if it flickers a bit. That's normal. It's… planned.
textes.(Il compte les pièces une par une. Sa mo: (He counts the coins one by one. His moustache trembles.) Three hundred… Exceptional. (He takes an old parchment out of his pocket, tied with a purple ribbon.) The title deed. And the key: it was my grandmother's. The house is yours. It's waiting for you. A house is a place that waits for you.
textes.(Il déroule la toile sur l'herbe. Un sol: (He unrolls the canvas on the grass. A sun, a cloud, a rainbow over it all. He says nothing for a long time.) … She finished it. (With Galet's ropes, with big sailor's gestures, he hoists it at the back of the stage. It snaps in the wind, then pulls taut.) Look at that. The more you pull, the better it holds. Only one thing is missing: the sound. Go and see Mégaphone, in the control booth. Tell her it's time. She'll understand.
textes.(Il joue. C'est… très fort. Un chat s'en: (He plays. It's… very loud. A cat flees through the window. A flowerpot cracks. Somewhere, a dog howls.) … So? So?
textes.(Il le prend dans ses deux grosses mains: (He takes it in his two big hands. The heart wobbles like a custard.) The Royal jelly heart… By my beard. By my three braids. By Rissole's pie. (He cries, of course.) Kid, you've just done what I never did. I panicked on the third floor. You went all the way to the bottom, and came back. Odon is going to have to buy more red ink.
textes.(Il met un doigt devant sa bouche : chut: (He puts a finger to his lips: shh. Then he pretends to hand you a cup of tea. Invisible. He waits for you to drink.)
textes.(Il mord dedans, la bouche pleine.) Merc: (He bites into it, mouth full.) Thanksh! Here, this is Xan. Only let go of him for important things. And this too: Peek' dug up some enormous bones. For the jaguars, like in the story!
textes.(Il pose chaque objet sous la vitrine co: (He places each object under the glass the way you'd set down a bird's egg.) A seashell... it's shaped like a little house! A feather... does it talk? No? Pity. A scarab... is it alive? It's made of stone. Fascinating too. A patch... a screaming rat, with a mohawk. My favourite. And the golden turnip... (The turnip shivers a little.) It moves! It no longer runs, but it moves! Fascinating, fascinating, FASCINATING!
textes.(Il pose la main sur le sable et te rega: (He lays his hand on the sand and looks at you.) … Boom. Now you know.
textes.(Il pose les éclats sur l'établi, entre: (He sets the shards on the workbench, between the three astral crystals. His hands, usually so abrupt, become very gentle. A blue light passes from one crystal to another. The shards begin to beat together, at the same rhythm.) … There. They're ready. (He sniffs.) Crystal dust. It stings. Now they have to go back to the Heart, at the very top of the Spire. The stairs have been closed for three hundred years. But you have the Glider. Land at the summit, and give it back its light.
textes.(Il prend les baguettes comme on prend u: (He takes the sticks the way you'd take a bird. He twirls them once between his fingers, without even thinking. Then he taps the edge of a bench: a roll so fast, so clean, that three pigeons fly off and one of Chaussette's dogs sits down to listen.) ... They're perfect. (He turns bright red.) But... get up on stage? In front of everyone? In front of Rouille? I... Come tonight. Stay close to me. If you're there, maybe I'll dare.
textes.(Il salue bien bas. Il te tend un chapea: (He bows low. He holds out an invisible hat. You put an invisible coin in it. He looks delighted… and gives you a real coin in return!)
textes.(Il salue encore. Il est très content d': (He bows again. He's very happy to have an audience.)
textes.(Il te fait coucou. Sans un mot.): (He waves at you. Without a word.)
textes.(Il te fait un petit signe sans arrêter: (He gives you a little wave without stopping his nodding.)
textes.(Il te montre ton oreille, puis le mur d: (He points at your ear, then the wall of sound, and gives a thumbs up.) … Still clean. You said so.
textes.(Khéty les soupèse, et siffle.) Elles so: (Khety weighs them in his hand, and whistles.) They're longer than my fingers! I'm hanging them on the prow right now. Sobek, the crocodile god, won't hold it against me: they were thieves.
textes.(L'Aigle te regarde longtemps.) Les anci: (The Eagle looks at you for a long time.) The elders say the Fifth Sun will stop one day. Not today. Not thanks to you. Keep the Feather: its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns, in the highlands. And take this, for the road.
textes.(Mixtli te tape sur l'épaule, fort.) Toi: (Mixtli slaps you on the shoulder, hard.) You, you have a jaguar's heart. Here: bones from their meals. In Xibalba, among the Maya, they're useful, it seems. And some coins.
textes.(Mère Morille te l'a dit : un champignon: (Mère Morille told you: a storybook mushroom, yes; an unknown mushroom in the real forest: NEVER.)
textes.(Plus rien aujourd'hui : revenez demain,: (Nothing left today: come back tomorrow, new notices will be pinned up.)
textes.(Prends-le en main dans ton sac, puis E: (Hold it in your bag, then press E in front of whatever you want to paint.)
textes.(Tom accorde son violon, tape du pied, e: (Tom tunes his fiddle, taps his foot, and sings at the top of his voice.)
textes.(Ton sac est plein : le reste t'attend,: (Your bag is full: the rest will wait for you, and you'll pick it up as soon as there's room.)
textes.(Ton sac est plein : reviens chercher la: (Your bag is full: come back for the map!)
textes.(Tout bas) Chuuut ! Le petit vient ENFIN: (Whispering) Shhh! The little one has JUST fallen asleep. I've been singing for three hours. If you wake him, you'll be the one rocking him until tomorrow.
textes.(Tout bas) Il dort comme une pierre. Une: (Whispering) He sleeps like a rock. A very, very small rock. Thanks again, big fella.
textes.(Tu cries dans le micro. Le larsen fait: (You scream into the mic. The feedback knocks over a flowerpot. The neighbor's dog starts howling in rhythm.) … YEAH! THAT WAS PERFECT! You're hired!
textes.(Tu croques. Tu ne pleures pas. Enfin… u: (You crunch. You don't cry. Well… a single tear. Smoke comes out of your ears.) Admirable! The jury is moved. The jury is also coughing a little. Trial of the sparks: passed!

textes.AAAH ! (Ougha saute derrière le totem. L: AAAH! (Ougha leaps behind the totem. So does the Clan. Then everyone bursts out laughing.) Ha! Ha! Ha! You funny, smooth thing! You stay!

textes.AIRE D'ENVOL\nAu bout de la piste,\ndépl:
LAUNCH PAD
At the end of the runway,
unfold the Alouette!
textes.AMMIT LA DÉVOREUSE ! La mangeuse de cœur: AMMIT THE DEVOURER! The eater of hearts: crocodile head, lion and hippo body. Dodge her charges, strike when she recovers.
textes.AMÉLIORER ? (Ses yeux brillent.) Ta mach: UPGRADE? (His eyes sparkle.) Your machine from the Cliquetis inventors, with its balloon and its propellers? It's magnificent! Brave! Noisy! What if we gave it a crystal heart? No more balloon: a saucer hull. No more propellers: a silent astral engine that climbs up to six hundred metres! The Star Glider! I need three astral crystals, two meteorite fragments, four gears and two rolls of sailcloth for the cabin. And for navigation, a hologram chip: Professor Quasar blew one up this morning. And a star chart: Sextant draws very beautiful ones. Can you bring me all that? I'll build you the finest machine in the archipelago. Promise. Clack!
textes.APOPHIS, LE SERPENT DU CHAOS ! L'ennemi: APOPHIS, THE SERPENT OF CHAOS! The enemy of Ra, who wants to swallow the sun every night. Back off when he rears his head, strike when he drops.

only goes down to floors already visited (it is careful)

WARNING:
the cracked tiles are not cracked.

textes.ATTENTION : JETS DE VAPEUR\nPasser entre:
WARNING: STEAM JETS
Pass between the bursts.
(Or don't. But rather do.)
textes.AUTRE MONDE ! (Tout le Clan fait « Ooooh: OTHER WORLD! (The whole Clan goes “Ooooh”.) Old Flint was right: land of the Smooth Ones, beyond big water! There, all round? All soft? Even rocks? Incredible.
textes.AVIS N° 4012 : vous êtes prié d'être ail: NOTICE No. 4012: you are kindly requested to be elsewhere.
textes.Abyssos ! J'ai une nouvelle version pour: Abyssos! I've got a new version for you!
textes.Abyssos ! J'ai une question pour tes rou: Abyssos! I've got a question for your scrolls!
textes.Abyssos ? Il archive chacune de mes erre: Abyssos? He's been archiving every one of my mistakes for nearly a thousand years. My successes, never. “That isn't history,” he says.
textes.Abyssos dit que la baleine parle au cris: Abyssos says the whale talks to the crystal. I asked him what it says. He searched for three days through all his scrolls, and then admitted he didn't know. It's the first time Abyssos hasn't known something! I wrote it on a pebble, so he'll remember.
textes.Abyssos m'a demandé d'archiver mes recet: Abyssos asked me to archive my recipes. I refused. Secrets aren't for writing down.
Abyssos receives my report every evening. He reads the whole thing, even though it's three words long. A serious man. A bit chatty, for a serious man.
textes.Abyssos sait tout sur tout, sauf ce qu'i: Abyssos knows everything about everything, except what's up there. So we're a team: I ask you the questions, and he writes down the answers.
textes.Abyssos veut tout écrire, même mes recet: Abyssos wants to write everything down, even my recipes. Secrets aren't written, they're handed on. He's sweet, but he's got a quill where his nose should be.
textes.Abyssos écrit l'histoire morte, moi je r: Abyssos writes dead history, I tell living history. He calls me a liar, I call him a scroll. We're fond of each other, deep down. Very deep down.
textes.Abyssos était le plus petit copiste du p: Abyssos was the smallest copyist in the palace, the night of the wave. A thousand years later, he still writes down everything I say. Even my sighs.
textes.Abyssos, tu as encore passé la nuit sous: Abyssos, you spent the night under my windows again.
textes.Abyssos. Si tu sors ta plume, je range m: Abyssos. If you get your quill out, I put my crackers away.
textes.Accomplir dix quêtes pour les habitants: Complete ten quests for the people of Port-Azur
textes.Accoster sur l'Île des Trois Soleils: Land on the Island of the Three Suns
textes.Accoster sur l'île des nains: Land on the island of the dwarves
textes.Accoster à Néopolis, sur le Quai des Dro: Land at Neopolis, on the Drone Quay
textes.Accroche-toi, j'ai le pied marin. Enfin,: Hold on tight, I've got sea legs. Well, all four of them.
textes.Accroché à la poignée… Attention au dépa: Hanging on to the handle… Watch out for the departure!
textes.Achille Buvard, le poète du village, a v: Achille Buvard, the village poet, saw the pot of orange (no. 7) stuck right at the top of the Ink Waterfall, on the Lip (the edge of the cliff, where the water falls). He gets dizzy with heights and with rhymes.
textes.Achille, voici l'orange ! J'ai même gard: Achille, here's the orange! I even kept my feet dry.
textes.Achille, vous écrivez sur la cascade ?: Achille, are you writing about the waterfall?
textes.Achète un virus, le deuxième est OFFERT: Buy one virus, the second is FREE!
textes.Admirer la machine à bulles de Basile Bu: Admire Basile Bulle's bubble machine (Fair stand, west side)
textes.Agenouille-toi. … « Rê qui renais chaque: Kneel. … “Ra, who is reborn each morning, give this one back the strength of his day.” There. You are new, like the sun at dawn.
textes.Agitée. Je n'arrive pas à rester sur pla: Restless. I can't keep still. See? There, I'm moving.
textes.Agrafe et Pigment ont imprimé les affich: Agrafe and Pigment have printed the posters for the next Great Boucan. For the whole world to come, they must be taken to the other islands: to Paulo, in Port-Azur; to Ulric, the innkeeper of Montjoie; and to Tom the Fiddler, at the Crâne Fendu, on Balafre Island.
textes.Ah ! Enfin ! Une personne raisonnable !: Ah! At last! A reasonable person! Legends are memories that have lost their papers, you see. You just have to give them back.
textes.Ah ! Enfin quelqu'un qui l'avoue sans ro: Ah! Finally someone who admits it without blushing. You're quite right. The world would be gentler if we read more kisses in the rain and fewer newspapers.
textes.Ah ! Excellente question ! Je vous répon: Ah! Excellent question! I'll answer in four minutes. (He takes a breath.) Right. In the name of the Council, the Elder, the Spire, the bridges, the domes and the planets of the fountain... Well, I can see from your face that you prefer the short version. Tradition says three things. One: have Ecliptic, the head of protocol, put you in the visitors' register, at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Spire. Two: taste Gloubi's stellar tea, at the Nebula Café, on the Agora. Three: go and greet Elder Astrée. After that, you'll no longer be a mere Heavyfoot. You'll be an official Heavyfoot. That's much better. There's a badge.
Ah! The friend of passing time. Come in.
textes.Ah ! La famille ! Un peu, la première fo: Ah! Family! A bit, the first time… and then it passes? Good, good. Maybe one day I'll try. On a day when the sea is very flat.
textes.Ah ! Le pain ! Sans pain, la bouillabais: Ah! The bread! Without bread, the bouillabaisse is an orphan. Grazie mille!
textes.Ah ! Le pain d'Honorine ! (Elle le renif: Ah! Honorine's bread! (She sniffs it, delighted.) It smells of morning. Thank you, my chick. Sit down, you've come all this way… No? You still have two loaves? Then at least take a slice for the road. Eat!
textes.Ah ! Le parfum ! Tiens, trois punchs, et: Ah! That smell! Here, three punches, and a few coins. At the Perroquet, you're at home.
textes.Ah ! Le pêcheur ! Ma vieille canne te va: Ah! The angler! My old rod suits you like a glove, {surnom}. Are they biting?
textes.Ah ! Les fêtes de village, les meilleure: Ah! Village parties, the best ones. A string of lights, a squeaky fiddle, old folks dancing badly. I was probably one of those old folks. Maybe even at yours.
textes.Ah ! Merci, Gunnar. Que ferais-je sans t: Ah! Thank you, Gunnar. What would I do without you?
textes.Ah ! Mon client ! Assieds-toi, assieds-t: Ah! My customer! Sit down, sit down.
textes.Ah ! Splendid ! Un aventurier, je le voi: Ah! Splendid! An adventurer, I can tell by your boots. Lord Archibald Pemberton, collector of curiosities. Do you have anything extraordinary to sell me, old bean?
textes.Ah ! Toi aussi ? Ça me rassure, tu peux: Oh! You too? You have no idea how much better that makes me feel. We should start a club. Nobody would talk. It would be very peaceful.
Ah! Ulfa is calling me. Royally.
textes.Ah ! Un adversaire ! Très bien. Mais je: Ah! An opponent! Very well. But I'm warning you: I haggled with a bumblebee the day I was born, and I won.
textes.Ah ! Un assistant ! Tu tombes à pic. App: Ah! An assistant! Just in time. Press the red button over there. No, not that one. The other one. There.
textes.Ah ! Un chercheur. Tu ouvres toutes les: Ah! A seeker. You open every box, don't you? Careful: some answers are much smaller than their questions.
textes.Ah ! Un collectionneur ! Tu vas adorer m: Ah! A collector! You're going to love my shop. Snow globe, authentic shell, postcard signed by yours truly… For you, friend's price. Well, almost friend's price.
textes.Ah ! Un frère de cordes ! Tu vois, c'est: Ah! A brother of the strings! You see, it's the only way. The only problem is that after a hundred years, the song gets a bit long.
textes.Ah ! Un futur chevalier, je le vois à to: Ah! A future knight, I can see it in your eyes! Do you want to become my squire?
textes.Ah ! Un modèle ! Ne bouge plus ! Tu veux: Ah! A model! Hold still! Would you pose for me? Choose your pose!
textes.Ah ! Un nouveau venu plein de bonne volo: Ah! A newcomer full of good will! Start by making the rounds: say hello to Odette at the harbour office, Edmond at the hotel and Toni at the Perroquet Bleu. Tell them the mayor sent you. Then come back and see me.
textes.Ah ! Un oiseau de nuit ! Tu es chez toi,: Ah! A night owl! You're at home here. The Perroquet is open until one. After that, there are the stars, but they don't serve drinks.
textes.Ah ! Un pointeur ! Un vrai ! Viens là qu: Ah! A pointer! A real one! Come here and let me shake your hand. Pointing is an art: you look, you breathe, you bend your knees. Shooters just throw and pray.
textes.Ah ! Un visiteur aux pieds pas en pierre: Ah! A visitor whose feet aren't made of stone. Sit down. Do you want to know the legend of the Great Moai? Everybody knows it here. But nobody listens to the end. They all fall asleep.
textes.Ah ! Un vrai ! Viens que je t'embrasse !: Ah! A true one! Come here and let me hug you! For you, double rouille and a chilli from the hill. If you cry, it means it's good.
Ah! … Why? I haven't done anything to you.
textes.Ah ? Je le lui dirai, ça lui fera plaisi: Oh? I'll pass that on, it'll make their day.
textes.Ah ? Je n'avais pas remarqué. Je regarde: Oh? I hadn't noticed. I'll look more closely.
textes.Ah bon ? C'est facile ! Tu prends un sea: Really? It's easy! You take a bucket, put in wet sand, pat it, turn it over. If it breaks, never mind, you say it's ruins.
textes.Ah bon ? Quelle tristesse. Une bière pou: Really? How sad. A fizz to cheer you up?
Oh no! No more cheap programs. Now Mr. Fil sells programs checked by Glitch. She hasn't checked any yet… so I'm not selling any. Honest business is very restful.
textes.Ah non ! Pas celui-là. Il est à vendre,: Oh no! Not that one. It's for sale, yes, but… not today. Nor tomorrow, for that matter.
textes.Ah non ! Pas déjà ! … Bon, d'accord, t'a: Oh no! Already?! … Okay, fine, you win. Here's your prize.
textes.Ah non, mes prix sont déjà doux comme la: Oh no, my prices are already as gentle as the sea in August.
Oh yeah? … Phew. I feel less silly. I've got three hundred crates with names. Want me to introduce you? Not all of them. The nicest ones.
textes.Ah oui ? Alors montre-moi le pas du crab: Oh yeah? Then show me the crab step. … Hmm. Not bad! Still a bit stiff in the knees. One class and you'll be ahead of the cat.
textes.Ah oui ? Alors pourquoi tes genoux sont: Oh yes? Then why are your knees all green?
textes.Ah oui ? … Bon. Alors c'est que c'est im: Have I? … Right. Then it must be important. I've been nodding my head for an hour, I can't remember who I've asked. Drink anyway.
textes.Ah oui, c'est vrai ! Il y a des noirs ge: Oh yes, that's true! There are nice darks, like the one we sleep in, and nasty darks, like under the brambles. You really think things through.
Ah, well… Three coins, and I'll look.
textes.Ah, CE genou ! Il est presque guéri, je: Oh, THAT knee! It's almost healed, I swear.
textes.Ah, Cardamome… Assieds-toi. C'est une lo: Ah, Cardamome… Sit down. It's a long story.
textes.Ah, bonjour ! Belle journée, n'est-ce pa: Ah, hello! Lovely day, isn't it?
textes.Ah, c'est toi ! Entre, entre. Excuse le: Ah, it's you! Come in, come in. Excuse the mess, I wasn't expecting company.
textes.Ah, c'est toi ! Entre, entre. Mets-toi à: Ah, it's you! Come in, come in. Make yourself at home, we're all friends here.
textes.Ah, c'est toi ! Merci de m'avoir réveill: Ah, it's you! Thanks for waking me up. I missed everything: the feast of the year 1300, the feast of the year 1400… Well. I'll take a little nap to recover.
textes.Ah, c'est toi ? Merci ! J'allais rater…: Ah, it's you? Thanks! I was about to miss… my afternoon nap. Well. Good night.
textes.Ah, c'est toi. Tu ne viendrais pas avec: Ah, it's you. You wouldn't happen to be bringing wood, would you?
textes.Ah, c'est vous. Toujours pas de rouage,: Ah, it's you. Still no cogwheel, I suppose.
textes.Ah, celles-là… Elles sont à moi. Je croi: Ah, those ones… They're mine. I think.
textes.Ah, l'amateur de coquillages. Si Victor: Ah, the shell lover. If Victor sells you an “authentic” one, bring it to me. I'll tell you whether it smells of paint.
textes.Ah, l'aventurier ! Vous savez, j'ai fait: Ah, the adventurer! You know, I took some very nice photos of the lighthouse.
textes.Ah, l'aventurier en personne ! Alors, le: Ah, the adventurer in person! So, how's the big wide world?
textes.Ah, l'invincible ! Tu as toujours ton po: Ah, the invincible one! Still got your jar of seaweed? The invincible need it more than anyone.
textes.Ah, la technique de Momo ! On ne se couc: Ah, the Momo technique! Don't go to bed, head straight out. Works once. The second time, you sleep at the bottom of the boat.
textes.Ah, le coureur ! Fontaine-phare, tu conn: Ah, the runner! Fountain to lighthouse, you know the way. Me, I know my time. Well… I used to.
textes.Ah, le diplomate ! « Les deux », tu disa: Ah, the diplomat! “Both,” you said. Raymond heard about it. He smiled. First time in years.
textes.Ah, le lève-tôt ! Tu as vu le soleil se: Ah, the early bird! Did you see the sun rise this morning? Tell me about it. I've never seen it.
textes.Ah, le renifleur ! Vas-y, sens. Ça sent: Ah, the sniffer! Go on, smell. Smells of the sea, yes or no? Right. Not in front of the sergeant.
textes.Ah, les gens… Demande, je te dirai ce qu: Ah, people… Ask away, I'll tell you what I know.
textes.Ah, les gens… Demandez, je vous dirai ce: Ah, people… Ask away, I'll tell you what I know.
textes.Ah, les meilleurs. Ceux qui dansent deda: Ah, the best kind. People who dance inside hear everything, even the silence between two kicks. Stay close to the sound: one day, it'll come out.
textes.Ah, mon ami ! Du nouveau sous la mer ?: Ah, my friend! Any news from under the sea?
textes.Ah, mon client au lit carré ! Votre cham: Ah, my neat-and-square guest! Your room is reserved at the guesthouse. It doesn't exist yet, but it's reserved.
textes.Ah, mon client fidèle ! J'ai mis de côté: Ah, my loyal customer! I've put aside a lovely cheese for you.
textes.Ah, mon client préféré ! Qu'est-ce que t: Ah, my favourite customer! What are you bringing me? What are you taking away?
textes.Ah, mon client préféré ! Tu m'apportes d: Ah, my favourite customer! Are you bringing me fish or buying some?
textes.Ah, mon enfant… Tu l'as remarqué, toi au: Ah, my child… You've noticed it too. For a week now, he's been sulking. His noodles are drooping, his eyes are half closed, and Mount Bolognese is rumbling. I searched the old books, and I found the recipe: the Dish of the Great Reconciliation. Fresh pasta from Mamma Lasagna, a ladleful of the sacred sauce from the Cooking Pot, and parmesan grated with the Golden Grater. The Golden Grater… Captain Rigatoni had it. He says he lost it. Me, I think he buried it. Will you help me? I can't leave the temple: if the Great Spaghetti opens an eye, someone has to smile at him.
textes.Ah, mon frère du safran ! J'en ai mis un: Ah, my saffron brother! I put an extra pinch in your portion. Not two, I'm not rich.
textes.Ah, mon gourmet ! Une table au soleil ?: Ah, my gourmet! A table in the sun?
textes.Ah, mon marcheur ! Tu as marché jusqu'ic: Ah, my walker! Did you walk all the way here? How long did that take? Me, four seconds.
textes.Ah, mon petit égaré ! Tu t'es encore per: Ah, my little wanderer! Have you got lost again since? Tell me where, I'll write it down on a shell.
textes.Ah, mon petit… C'est la Grande Averse. I: Ah, my little one… It's the Great Downpour. Ten days ago, a pure white cloud came from the sea, and it rained clear water. So clear that it washed the colours off everything: the leaves, the grass, the pond, our houses. We were asleep under our roofs, so we kept ours. But the Stone Palette overflowed, and the nine paint pots went off with the water. Without them, the island is just a colouring-book page. Here: this is the island's Brush, the elders' brush. It only paints with the colours of the Palette. And start with the pulley basket, under the Council terrace: Gaspard swears he heard a “plop”, the night of the Downpour. Me, I no longer have the strength to haul it up.
textes.Ah, mon supporter ! Viens voir, je vais: Ah, my supporter! Come and watch, I'm going to point. And if Raymond objects, you're my witness.
textes.Ah, mon terrien ! La mer est calme, ne t: Ah, my landlubber! The sea's calm, don't worry. If it rolls, look at the lighthouse. That usually works.
textes.Ah, mon étal ! Regarde, sens, goûte… enf: Ah, my stall! Look, smell, taste… well, pay first.
textes.Ah, notre arbitre ! Depuis ta visite, on: Ah, our referee! Since your visit, we don't argue anymore. Well, hardly anymore. Yesterday it was about the spoons.
textes.Ah, notre visiteur ! Comment trouvez-vou: Ah, our visitor! How do you like our little town?
textes.Ah, quelqu'un qui écoute ! C'est rare et: Ah, someone who listens! That's rare and precious, around here. Sit by the counter, I'll tell you everything people say. I know everything. I repeat nothing. Almost nothing.
textes.Ah, te voilà ! Viens par ici, on m'a rac: Ah, there you are! Come over here, I've been hearing things.
textes.Ah, toi qui es toujours pile à l'heure !: Ah, you who are always right on time! Good timing, it's time. I think. I've never been able to tell the time.
textes.Ah, toi. Assieds-toi si tu veux, mais ne: Ah, you. Sit down if you like, but don't step on the canvas.
textes.Ah, un curieux ! Donne ta main… Je vois: Ah, a curious one! Give me your hand… I see a road, water, lots of people waiting for you. And a soup at Paulo's. That one's certain: everyone ends up at Paulo's.
textes.Ah, un habitué ! Le hamac du fond est li: Ah, a regular! The hammock at the back is free, if you like.
textes.Ah, un sportif ! Ça se voit tout de suit: Ah, an athlete! I can tell right away. A little set of push-ups?
textes.Ah, un visiteur ! Tu veux savoir le secr: Ah, a visitor! Want to know the secret of ships in bottles? You put them in lying down, and pull the thread. Want to try?
textes.Ah, un voyageur ! Bienvenue à La Rose de: Ah, a traveller! Welcome to La Rose des Vents. Books, sea charts, and a bookseller who adores stories. Where are you from?
textes.Ah, un voyageur ! Dites-moi, c'est pour: Ah, a traveller! Tell me, it's for my map: where exactly do you come from?
textes.Ah, une vraie ! Les gens du soir, c'est: Ah, a real one! Night people are my family. We recognise each other by the bags under our eyes. Come and dance — we'll rest when the sea runs dry.
textes.Ah, voilà mon lève-tard ! Il reste des m: Ah, here's my late riser! There are some crumbs left, I think. Mochi! Leave some crumbs!
textes.Ah, voilà mon troqueur ! Toujours pas de: Ah, here's my swapper! Still no goat? The day you get one, I'll explain coins to you.
textes.Ah, voilà notre gagnant ! Tu viens rajou: Ah, here's our winner! Come to add a line to the record board? I've kept some paint.
textes.Ah, vous qui ne voulez pas de photo. Je: Ah, you're the one who doesn't want photos. I'll just look at you, then. With my eyes only. Is that allowed?
textes.Ah, vous voilà ! Venez par ici, on m'a r: Ah, there you are! Come over here, I've been hearing things.
textes.Ah, vous. Bon. Qu'est-ce qui vous amène: Ah, you. Right. What brings you here?
textes.Ah, vous. Encore une grosse pièce, je pa: Ah, you. Another big coin, I bet? I've kept change aside for you. On purpose. A whole drawerful.
textes.Ah, vous. Le lait. Je vous l'ai caché de: Ah, you. The milk. I've hidden it for you behind the sugar bowl, so nobody sees. You'll be the death of me.
textes.Ah, {surnom} ! Entre, entre. Enfin, mont: Ah, {surnom}! Come in, come in. Well, come up. You're already up. Right.
textes.Ah, {surnom} ! Le pain est tout chaud, c: Ah, {surnom}! The bread's nice and warm, as always.
Ah, {surnom}! Your nose looks in good shape. So does mine: I can smell you're about to buy something.
textes.Ah, {surnom} ! Viens voir, j'ai redessin: Ah, {surnom}! Come and see, I've redrawn the misty coast. It moves, I swear it moves.
textes.Ah, {surnom}. J'ai écrit trois rouleaux: Ah, {surnom}. I've written three scrolls about you. Want to read them? No? Nobody ever does.
Ah, {surnom}. My kingdom talks about you. Sit down. Not on the throne.
textes.Ah, {surnom}. Tu as une petite mine. Une: Ah, {surnom}. You look a bit peaky. Some herbal tea?
textes.Ah, {surnom}. Tu reviens pour la suite d: Ah, {surnom}. Back for the rest of the story? I can't remember where we'd got to. I'll start another one.
textes.Ah, {surnom}. Tu veux une histoire ? J'e: Ah, {surnom}. Want a story? I have three thousand. This one is short. Well, for an elf.
textes.Ah, {surnom}. Tu viens voir mes tissages: Ah, {surnom}. Have you come to see my weaving, or did Caelan send you?
textes.Ah. Alors la casquette, je te la rends d: Ah. Then I'll give you the cap back tomorrow.
textes.Ah. C'est toi. Je comptais mes coquillag: Ah. It's you. I was counting my shells. I'd got to… drat, I've lost count.
textes.Ah. C'est toi. … Bonjour. Ne t'y habitue: Ah. It's you. … Hello. Don't get used to it.
textes.Ah. Elle les mange, au moins ?: Oh. She does eat them, at least?
textes.Ah. Euh. Il a changé d'avis ?: Ah. Um. Maybe it changed its mind?
Oh. Good. I feel better already.
Ah. Same place as always, then.
textes.Ah. Tu l'as vu, toi aussi, les nuits cla: Ah. You've seen it too, on clear nights: a castle, way up high, on an island floating above the ocean. The Citadel of the Clouds, fortress of the Sky Kings. Nori says it was from up there that the lightning woke our golems… Nobody goes up there. Except the great eagles. There's one left: Ventaile. The golems chained her at the edge of the crater, above the path. Free her, feed her — fish, she loves fish — and put this on her back: the saddle of Forgefer's last eagle riders.
textes.Ahhh ! Enfin quelqu'un ! Viens là, je te: Ahhh! Finally, someone! Come here, I'll make you a free necklace. OK, half price. OK, free. You deserve it.
textes.Ahoy, {surnom} ! La marée est bonne aujo: Ahoy, {surnom}! The tide is good today, and so are you, by the look of it.
textes.Ah… Splendid. Les plus beaux objets sont: Ah… Splendid. The finest objects are the ones that keep someone inside. Take good care of it. Never sell it to me, even if I beg. Especially if I beg.
textes.Ah… Tu as vu la porte sculptée dans son: Ah… You've seen the door carved into its trunk. Beneath the Mother Tree sleeps the Kingdom of Roots, the land of the fairies. Long ago, five firefly spirits guarded its door; one stormy evening they flew off into the forest, and the door closed. Take this fairy lantern. The spirits dance above the rings of white mushrooms all around the village. Bring them home, and the door will open.
textes.Ah… Tu es comme moi avant. Mais attentio: Ah… You're like I used to be. But careful, the party gets hold of you. One weekend, and boom. Three weeks from now, you'll be sleeping with crabs.
textes.Ah… Un grand. Les runes me l'avaient dit: Ah… A tall one. The runes told me. Nori, keeper of the runes. Sit down, and speak softly: the stones are listening.
textes.Ah… les cartes m'avaient dit que tu revi: Ah… the cards told me you'd be back.
textes.Ah… tu les as vus briller, mon petit cha: Ah... you saw them shine, my little mushroom. Those are the fairy mushrooms. They only exist in tales, and in this cathedral, which is a bit of a tale itself. There are five: the Spring Bolete, the Moonwort, the Chatterer, the Rainbow and the Little Giant. Go pick them, one of each, and bring them back to me: I'll tell you what each one does. But listen carefully, this is the most important part. (She rests her hand on your shoulder.) In a tale, yes. In the real forest: never! Never, ever eat a mushroom you don't know. Even if it's pretty. Especially if it's pretty. Promise?
textes.Aimes-tu les fenêtres surprises ? Clique: Do you like surprise windows? Click “yes” to get more.
textes.Alex et Alain !: In and Out! (In Side and Out Side!)
textes.Aller au Bois-Doré, chez les elfes, et a: To go to the Bois-Doré, to the elves, and learn the remedies no book contains. I'd take notes everywhere, even on my sleeves.
textes.Aller au Cercle des Pierres-Lunes (à l'o: Go to the Circle of Moonstones (west of the Academy) and lay your hand on the altar (E)
textes.Aller au Cirque du Crâne, au bout de la: Go to Skull Hollow, at the far end of Balafre, with the map: defeat Captain Fleshless, who guards the treasure
textes.Aller au royaume des fées de Lulu, là-ha: To go to Lulu's fairy kingdom, up there, above the clouds. No boat, just one bite. And plant a banana tree up there, so the fairies have dessert.
textes.Aller dire ses quatre vérités à Monsieur: Go and give Mr Fil a piece of your mind (at his stall in the Alleys, in the afternoon and evening)
textes.Aller saluer la Doyenne Astrée (à la Sal: Go and greet Elder Astrée (at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Spire, in the daytime; on her bench in the Agora during the Night of the Auroras)
textes.Aller sur une île ou une grande place: Go to an island or a main square
textes.Aller voir Volt, l'ingénieur de l'énergi: Go and see Volt, the energy engineer (at the foot of the Crystal Spire, in the daytime and during the Night of the Auroras)
textes.Aller voir Zéro (sur la Place des Hologr: Go and see Zéro (on the Hologram Square in the daytime, at the quay in the evening)
Off you go. And drop by again.
Come on, somebody take him back to the dock.
textes.Allez, sors de là, mon petit charbon !: Come on, come out, my little ember!
textes.Allez, un dernier pour la route. Et je t: Go on, one last one for the road. And I'll tuck one in for tomorrow!
Go ahead. I'm getting out my notebook.
textes.Allez-y. Poussez la porte. Le lit est fa: Go on. Push the door open. The bed is made. The shelf is empty, but not for long. And in the evening, when I walk past… pay no attention to me. I'll just be checking whether the window is lit.
Long. Well. That's coffee on holiday. We respect that, in Port-Azur. I'll make it long for you.
textes.Allumer les cinq braseros de l'Aire des: Light the five braziers of the Duelling Ground in a row with the fireball (key 6 then V; in VR, left trigger), before the first one goes out
textes.Allumer les sept Grandes Lanternes de Pa: Light the seven Great Lanterns of Pandémonia with the ember lantern (the port, the market, the arena, the baths, the Academy, the Forge Cathedral, the Great Lantern Square)
textes.Aloha ! Bienvenue au Coco Loco ! Cocktai: Aloha! Welcome to the Coco Loco! Cocktails, shade, and terrible music on the house.
textes.Alors Thalion reviendra sans piqûre, pou: Then Thalion will come back without a sting, for once.
Then drink some more. For the puddle.
Then good morning. And get your feet off them.
Then it's the wind. As usual.
Then it must have changed its dress.
textes.Alors c'est toi qui as levé la main sur: So you're the one who raised a hand to {qn}… Never do it again. Never.
textes.Alors c'est vous qui avez levé la main s: So you're the one who raised a hand to {qn}… Never do it again. Never.
textes.Alors c'était une bonne fête. Les meille: Then it was a good party. The best ones, you forget. Me, I remember all of mine: that's because I made them up a little.
textes.Alors c'était une de celles-là. Fffiou !: Then it was one of those. Fffwoosh!
textes.Alors ce soir, je joue pour les fées aus: Then tonight, I'm playing for the fairies too.
textes.Alors celui-là, c'est de la tisane, et i: Then this one's herbal tea, and it counts for sleep.
textes.Alors chante avec moi. Ah non, c'est vra: Then sing with me. Oh no, that's right…
textes.Alors chante un peu, et je dirai qu'elle: Then sing a little, and I'll say they're from this morning!
textes.Alors chante-la encore. À mon âge, on ai: Then sing it again. At my age, one loves whatever grows.
textes.Alors comme ça, tu as rendu service à {q: So, you did {qn} a favour. Well. You've got a good heart. Too good, maybe.
textes.Alors comme ça, tu me trouves bizarre ?: So, you think I'm weird? {Qn} told me. Weird yourself.
textes.Alors comme ça, vous avez rendu service: So, you did {qn} a favour. Well. You've got a good heart. Too good, maybe.
textes.Alors comme ça, vous me trouvez bizarre: So, you think I'm weird? {Qn} told me. Weird yourself.
Then tell the canal to be careful.
textes.Alors dis-lui cinq heures. Et qu'il se t: Then tell it five o'clock. And tell it to keep quiet.
Then tell it not to move.
Then it was hiding in it.
textes.Alors je chanterai le premier. Deux fois: Then I'll sing the first one. Twice.
textes.Alors je collectionne les graines. Toute: So I collect seeds. All of them! Zéphyr brings me some from every island: from the jungle, from the elves, a dwarf cactus seed… I've got one thousand one hundred and eleven. I compare them to my shell, just in case. One day, I'll find the seed that looks like my hazelnut, and I'll know which tree I fell from.
textes.Alors je compte vite ! Un, deux, vingt-m: Then I'll count fast! One, two, twenty-thousand!
Then I'm going down. Don't fall asleep.
textes.Alors je joue doucement. Une demi-étoile: Then I'll play softly. Half a star.
Then I'll keep it for Nolwenn.
textes.Alors je le lui ai recommandé. Chaudemen: So I recommended it to her. Warmly. “The finest novel of the year, madam. The captain, the florist, the storm in chapter twelve…” She went red as a tomato. Over a novel! I even told her the ending, to convince her. She said thank you in a tiny little voice. Mainland people are so emotional.
Then I'll keep them for my hair.
textes.Alors je les mets dans le prochain morce: Then I'll put them in the next track.
textes.Alors je lui laisse une lanterne. Pour l: Then I'll leave her a lantern. For the night.
textes.Alors je monte la basse, Lulu. Pour là-h: Then I'll turn up the bass, Lulu. For up there.
textes.Alors je soigne la basse. C'est pour des: Then I'll take care with the bass. It's for royal ears.
textes.Alors je t'ai apporté une jolie pierre p: Then I brought you a pretty stone for nothing.
textes.Alors je te l'achète. Contre une questio: Then I'll buy it from you. For a question!
textes.Alors je te nourrirai couché. Comme l'hi: Then I'll feed you lying down. Like last winter.
Then I want to go there, to fairyland.
textes.Alors joue « Marée Basse ». Les arbres l: Then play “Low Tide”. The trees like it.
textes.Alors la carte est juste. Tant mieux. Ne: Then the map is accurate. Good. Don't touch the centre.
Then the moon is a lucky moon.
Then my keel's leaking, on the north side.
textes.Alors maintenant. Et ne chante pas le re: Then now. And don't sing the chorus.
Then eat standing up. But EAT.
textes.Alors mange vite, et personne ne m'enten: Then eat quickly, and nobody will hear me.
textes.Alors ne la fais pas trop attendre. Une: Then don't keep them waiting too long. A home that waits is a lantern kept lit: it burns its oil for you.
Then don't tell it; it was so touched.
textes.Alors nous sommes deux à le croire. Mais: Then there are two of us who believe it. But written doesn't mean legible. The runes always say it… a little crooked.
textes.Alors nous sommes deux à mal archiver no: Then there are two of us who archive our nights badly.
textes.Alors on se ressemble moins que je croya: Then we're less alike than I thought. Or more. One day you'll tell me what you see down there. I'll listen the way you listen to a song.
textes.Alors on échange ! Une grenouille contre: Then let's trade! One frog for three shells!
textes.Alors pourquoi il bat si fort quand elle: Then why does it beat so hard when she walks by?
textes.Alors prends deux pains : un pour aujour: Then take two loaves: one for today, one for courage.
textes.Alors raconte-moi la fin, que je vérifie: Then tell me the ending, so I can check if you're cheating.
Then stay on the surface. For once.
Then your show doesn't have an audience.
textes.Alors tu aimeras le Bois-Doré. Là-bas, o: Then you'll love Bois-Doré. There, we walk ABOVE the trees, too.
textes.Alors tu as un bon nez. Et ta grenouille: Then you've got a good nose. And your frog?
textes.Alors tu es de ceux qui rêvent fort. C'e: Then you are one of those who dream strongly. That's how one finds the way to the clouds, you know. The mushroom is only a door; the dream is the key.
textes.Alors tu reviendras toujours quelque par: Then you'll always come back somewhere, that's good. But while you're here, the soup is me. And nobody turns down my soup.
textes.Alors tu sais ce que c'est, de regarder: Then you know what it is to gaze at the horizon in the morning. Remember to write to them. A letter is a drop that crosses the clouds.
textes.Alors un peu moins cher, pour les tilleu: Then a little cheaper, for the lime trees.
textes.Alors {qn} t'a raconté mes histoires ? J: So {qn} told you my stories? I hope {il} didn't tell you everything.
textes.Alors {qn} vous a raconté mes histoires: So {qn} told you my stories? I hope {il} didn't tell you everything.
textes.Alors, Comète ? Qui paie les glaces ?: So, Comète? Who's paying for the ice creams?
textes.Alors, Fañch, les poissons sont bavards,: So, Fañch, are the fish chatty today?
textes.Alors, Lulu, tu reviens d'où, ce soir ?: So, Lulu, where are you back from tonight?
textes.Alors, Pépé, il pesait combien, ce matin: So, Grandpa, how much did your sea bass weigh this morning?
textes.Alors, ce lapin ? Il sort du trou, fait: So, that rabbit? Comes out of the hole, goes round the tree… You've been practising, I hope? Show me.
textes.Alors, dis-moi franchement : le hamac, l: So, tell me honestly: the hammock, last time… did you sleep well?
textes.Alors, franchement, entre nous, sans fla: So, honestly, between us, no flattery: what do you think of our little town?
textes.Alors, le grand, toujours à forger pour: So, big'un, still forging for the tourists?
textes.Alors, le grand, toujours à taper trop f: So, big'un, still hitting too hard on the left?
textes.Alors, le tireur, tu as touché quelque c: So, shooter, hit anything since? Apart from Marcel's feet?
textes.Alors, le très-vite ? On verra ça sous l: So, Speedy? We'll see about that under the arches. I'll wait for you at the start. Well, I'll wait for you at the finish.
textes.Alors, ma championne, tu pointes ?: So, my champion, are you pointing?
textes.Alors, mon marchandeur ? Prêt à perdre,: Well, my haggler? Ready to lose today? My prices are hard as crystal.
textes.Alors, navigateur, on part quand ?: So, navigator, when do we set sail?
textes.Alors, petit ? Ta cabane tient debout ?: Well, kid? Your hut still standing?
textes.Alors, ton épée, elle t'a répondu ? Ma b: So, has your sword answered you yet? My boat hasn't either. Patience, sailor, patience.
textes.Alors, tu as trouvé un nom pour ta lame: So, found a name for your blade? Not “Ouch”, eh. That one's taken.
textes.Alors, tu as écrit ? Non ? Mange d'abord: So, did you write? No? Eat first, write after. But write.
textes.Alors, tu l'as entendu, le petit boum ?: So, have you heard it, the little boom? The right place, I mean. I hear it every night.
textes.Alors, tu nages toujours « un peu » ? So: So, still swimming “a bit”? Breathe slowly, I'm telling you. And stay where I can see you.
textes.Alors, tu sais reconnaître un poisson fr: So, can you tell a fresh fish now? Recite: the eye, the gills, the skin. And the song.
textes.Alors, une galette pour le forgeron du g: So, a crêpe for the hinge smith?
textes.Alors, {surnom}, toi, à la taverne : tu: So, {surnom}, you, at the tavern: do you sing, do you dance, or do you listen?
textes.Alors… c'était le bouton d'un pirate. Un: Well… it was a pirate's button. A very elegant pirate.
Well then… twice upon a time.
textes.Alors… tu l'as vu, Octave. Il parle enco: So… you've seen him, Octave. Does he still talk about me?
textes.Altitude : idéale. Colis : intact. Pigeo: Altitude: ideal. Package: intact. Pigeon: annoying.
textes.Ami ? … Ougha réfléchit. (Ougha réfléchi: Friend? … Ougha think. (Ougha thinks very hard; it makes a noise.) All right. You friend. Smooth friend. First smooth friend of the Clan!
textes.Ami des fées ! Le royaume tout entier ch: Friend of the fairies! The whole kingdom sings your name.
textes.Ami, frère d'armes, compagnon de légende: Friend, brother in arms, companion of legend: I owe you a debt. Let me repay it with my sword. Whenever you like, just say “come with me”, and I, SIR TANCRÈDE DE TOURNEVENT, will charge at your side! One time in three, I'll fall. But the other two times… ah, the other two times!
textes.Amirale ! Vous avez vu ? J'ai redessiné: Admiral! Have you seen? I've redrawn the north coast!
textes.Ammit s'effondre et se dissout dans l'om: Ammit collapses and dissolves into the shadows. Anubis hasn't moved. You can stand before the scale again… and tell the truth this time.
textes.Ammit se ramasse… et se jette sur toi, g: Ammit crouches… and leaps at you, jaws wide open!
textes.Amoureuse. Comme au premier jour. Le onz: In love. Like on the first day. The eleventh day.
textes.Amélie m'a refusé le corail, et elle ava: Amélie refused me the coral, and she was right, I know. She knows every herb on the lookout. She couldn't find me my red.
textes.Amélie, c'est l'herboriste, et mon amie: Amélie is the herbalist, and my friend since the summer it didn't rain. I grow her thyme, she looks after my hands. We both dream of a flower nobody here has ever seen.
textes.Annoncer la victoire à Pépin, à la Clair: Tell Pépin about the victory, at the Games Clearing
textes.Annoncer à Matthias que la Porte aux Qua: Tell Matthias that the Gate of the Four Seals is open (Carène harbour master's office)
textes.Anouk ! J'ai une drôle de douleur, là, à: Anouk! I've got a funny pain, right here, on the left.
textes.Anouk ! Regarde, je me suis pas fait mal: Anouk! Look, I didn't hurt myself today!
textes.Anouk ! Un nouveau baume, au miel des pr: Anouk! A new balm, with meadow honey this time!
textes.Anouk me soigne de tout, même de ce que: Anouk treats me for everything, even things I don't have, and she never makes fun of me. And she's been keeping a secret for me for years, without ever making me pay for it in herbal tea.
textes.Anouk ne pose pas de questions. Elle ten: Anouk doesn't ask questions. She holds out a phial of oil, she takes back the empty one. We understand each other perfectly without talking. It's the best way.
textes.Anouk soigne mes genoux. Elle grogne un: Anouk patches up my knees. She grumbles a bit, but she blows on them before putting the seaweed on, like I'm five. I like it. Don't tell anyone.
textes.Anouk soigne tout Carène avec des algues: Anouk heals all of Carène with seaweed and the patience of a limpet. She thinks I don't know she finds my hot honey stash. I know. It's our little game.
textes.Anouk soigne tout le monde avec des algu: Anouk treats everyone with seaweed, even broken legs. She thinks my desert balms are useless. I think they smell lovely. We don't have the same criteria.
Anouk treats everyone with seaweed. Even colds. Even broken legs.
textes.Anouk, ma toux est revenue. Une histoire: Anouk, my cough's back. A story and a hot honey?
textes.Anselme ? Mon vieux copain du phare. Cin: Anselme? My old pal at the lighthouse. Fifty years we've been talking, and almost never face to face. Two calls, two flashes. The longest friendship in the archipelago, and the quietest.
textes.Anselme m'a appris à reconnaître chaque: Anselme taught me to recognise every boat by its light at night. The Swallow has a slightly yellow lamp, Fernand's boat a lantern that leans. That's how I saw, from the harbour office, that the beam was trembling: the lens was cracked. I climbed up to tell him. He knew. He was waiting for someone to notice.
textes.Anselme parle moins que son phare. Mais: Anselme talks less than his lighthouse. But he watches over the whole harbour, and over me too, from up there. I take him up soup. It's our way of saying things to each other.
textes.Anselme, au phare, a vu une lueur bleue: Anselme, at the lighthouse, saw a blue glow under the water, far to the west. He doesn't believe me when I tell him what it is.
textes.Anselme, c'est le frère de Marius. Il m': Anselme is Marius's brother. He holds a net against me. All I want is for us to talk again. We're not getting any younger, him or me.
textes.Anselme, c'est ma ligne d'arrivée. Il gr: Anselme is my finish line. He grumbles, he doesn't talk, he put up a sign for me. I'm fond of him, the old owl.
textes.Anselme, le gardien du phare, a perdu qu: Anselme, the lighthouse keeper, has lost something precious. It's weighing on him.
textes.Antée, le géant, te prend dans sa grande: Antaeus, the giant, takes you in his great stone hand, very gently, like a bird. “The Cocytus is down below. It's cold. You took a coat, I hope?” He sets you down at the bottom of the well.
textes.Apaiser le Gardien du Cœur: Calm the Guardian of the Heart
textes.Apaisé. Le faisceau porte à vingt milles: At peace. The beam reaches twenty miles. Sailors sleep soundly.
textes.Apophis crache un nuage de venin noir !: Apophis spits a cloud of black venom!
Apophis is defeated. Ra is saved.
textes.Apophis s'enfonce dans l'eau noire en si: Apophis sinks into the black water, hissing… defeated! Above the barque, the sun disc lights up again, first red as dawn, then gold. Ra is saved: tomorrow, the sun will rise. And in front of the barque, something glows…
textes.Apophis siffle : des scorpions sortent d: Apophis hisses: scorpions crawl out of the darkness!
textes.Apporter 2 dorades à Zohra, à la criée d: Bring 2 sea bream to Zohra, at the Tazira fish market (use a fishing rod, at the end of the jetty for example)
textes.Apporter 3 minerais de fer au professeur: Bring 3 iron ore to Professor Boum, in front of his workshop (west of Cliquetis, near the cliffs)
textes.Apporter la puce holographique et la car: Bring the hologram chip and the star chart to Ionie (in the Spaceport hangar)
textes.Apporter le miel à Bobor, au Four Éterne: Bring the honey to Bobor, at the Eternal Oven (the bakery in the Great Market)
textes.Apporter les cinq bouquets à Xóchitl (su: Bring the five bouquets to Xóchitl (on the chinampas, or at the market)
textes.Apporter les cinq fleurs à Mère Brasille: Bring the five flowers to Mother Brasille (at the Ash Gardens)
textes.Apporter les cordes et la toile à Jack (: Bring the ropes and the canvas to Jack (in the Festival Meadow, in front of the Main Stage, in the daytime)
textes.Apporter les trois champignons à Mère Sa: Bring the three mushrooms to Mother Sage (at the herb garden, south of the Academy)
textes.Apporter les trois cristaux à Violette (: Bring the three crystals to Violette (at a Guild table, or at the Upper Town lookout in the afternoon)
textes.Apporter les trois cristaux à Zigomar (à: Bring the three crystals to Zigomar (at his inventor's workshop)
textes.Apporter les trois flocons à Borée Givre: Bring the three flakes to Borée Givrelin (on the shore of Mirror Lake, north-east of the Academy)
textes.Apporter les trois fragments à Zénith (à: Bring the three fragments to Zénith (at the Observatory, on the islet to the north, across the bridge of light; he sleeps in the morning and works from evening until dawn)
textes.Apporter les trois lots de pièces à Rust: Bring the three batches of parts to Rustine (at the Spinning Mill bike workshop)
textes.Apporter les trois paniers à Lentille (à: Bring the three baskets to Lentille (at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen, on the ground floor of the Cannery)
textes.Apporter les trois plumes à Zéphyrine Pl: Bring the three feathers to Zéphyrine Plume (at the foot of the Leaning Tower, in the south of the island)
textes.Apporter les trois touffes au Doc (Fulbe: Bring the three tufts to the Doc (Fulbert Saignée, in front of his door, near the forge)
textes.Apporter les trois éclats de lune à Auré: Bring the three moon shards to Aurélien Lumen (near the Observatory, north-west of the Academy; at the library in the afternoon)
textes.Apporter trois bûches à Pyra Flammèche (: Bring three logs to Pyra Flammèche (at the Duelling Ground, east of the Academy)
textes.Apporter un cristal de soufre à Mademois: Bring a sulphur crystal to Miss Sulfura (at the Academy; Bulle sells them at the Sulphur Baths)
textes.Apporter une galette de maïs à Kinich (I: Bring a corn cake to Kinich (Ix Chab sells them on the square of Yaxché)
textes.Apporter à Clémence un corail rouge (fon: Bring Clémence a red coral (bottom of the bay, to the west), some honey and a coconut
textes.Apporter à Hector deux bûches et trois c: Bring Hector two logs and three pebbles
textes.Apporter à Ionie trois cristaux astraux,: Bring Ionie three astral crystals, two meteorite fragments, four gears and two rolls of sailcloth (Ionie and Nébula sell them; fragments also fall on shooting-star nights) — Ionie is in the Spaceport hangar, to the east
textes.Apporter à Lord Pemberton une plume de V: Bring Lord Pemberton one of Ventaile's feathers, a naga scale or a shark tooth
textes.Apporter à Volt les trois éclats et troi: Bring Volt the three shards and three astral crystals (at the foot of the Crystal Spire)
textes.Apprendre la magie ? … Le Cristal a frém: Learn magic? … The Crystal trembled. Good sign. Listen: every apprentice starts with a spellbook. Go see Théophraste at the library: he'll give you one, brand new, with blank pages. Then introduce yourself to Pip: he's the youngest of the apprentices, and the chattiest; he'll show you everything. Then come back to me, in the courtyard of the Great Crystal.
textes.Apprendre la télékinésie avec Théophrast: Learn telekinesis with Théophraste Filandre, at the library
textes.Apprendre les six sorts des maîtres d'Ar: Learn the six spells of the masters of Arcanelle: light, fire, frost, levitation, telekinesis and healing
textes.Approche, jeune humain. Assieds-toi. Je: Come closer, young human. Sit down. I am Faelar. I watched that tree grow, and that one, and… ah, no, that one was already tall.
textes.Approche, le grand. Approche. Thorgal Ma: Come closer, big one. Closer. Thorgal Marteau-d'Or, king of Forgefer, lord of the Fire Mountain. You may bow. … Lower.
textes.Approche, petit. N'aie pas peur de mes o: Come closer, little one. Don't be afraid of my ears: they're old, but they can still hear hearts beating. I am Mère-Lune. Welcome to Ramure, the village of ears.
textes.Approche, petit. Une question de marin,: Come here, youngster. A sailor's question, a real one: can you tie a bowline?
textes.Approche, regarde. Tout vient de la mer: Come closer, have a look. Everything comes from the sea or the hold. You have {pieces} coins.
textes.Approche, {surnom}, côté droit. Je n'ent: Come closer, {surnom}, on the right side. I can hardly hear anything in my left ear. Years glued to the speakers, before Bastien invented his earplugs. If Tchoum tunes the sound, it's because he hears what I can't any more. He knows — only him. The others, I don't want them to worry: a half-deaf DJ is either funny or frightening.
textes.Approche, {surnom}, et parle pas fort. M: Come closer, {surnom}, and keep your voice down. I never wanted to be mayor. I only ran because Marcel bet I wouldn't dare. His measurement was wrong, I saw it straight away: my ball was closer. And I was relieved. Since then, I cry “Thief!”, because it makes him so happy to have beaten me. He's my best friend. Don't tell him.
textes.Approche, {surnom}, que personne n'enten: Come closer, {surnom}, so no one hears. I've forgotten the ending. The ending of my best story, the moon that wouldn't go to bed, the one my mother used to tell me. So when we get to the end, I start another story, and nobody notices. Except maybe Mother Moon. She always pretends to fall asleep at just the right moment. I think she knows it.
textes.Approche, {surnom}. La lune ne m'a pas s: Come closer, {surnom}. The moon didn't only tell me to go home. It entrusted me with a secret, at the bottom of the big pond: the seal of the mists. Where, I won't say until it has spoken to you, yourself. I'm afraid of leaving with the mist before I've passed it on. I had thought of Brume. But Brume reads tracks… and the moon, she doesn't hear it.
textes.Approche, {surnom}. Plus près. Il n'y a: Come closer, {surnom}. Closer. There is no secret. Nonna passed away one winter, before she could tell me. In her notebook, the last line just stops: “dieci pesci, zafferano, e…” And nothing. Twenty-five years I've been pretending. Sometimes I think the secret is Rosalie singing while she guts the fish. If you repeat this to her, I'll serve you soup. Real soup.
textes.Approche-toi et appuie sur E pour monter: Get close and press E to climb on. To call her from afar: G (or “Use” the feather in the inventory).
textes.Approche-toi et appuie sur la gâchette p: Get close and press the trigger to climb on. To call her from afar: X button (left hand).
textes.Approche. Plus près. … Mes yeux baissent: Come here. Closer. … My eyes are failing, {surnom}. For two years now. Beyond the big pond, it's all mist. The monster of the False Alarm, maybe that was it. “Nothing to report” is also because I can't see any more. Brume tells me what she smells without me asking. Nobody knows. Except that owl Hulotte. He offered me spectacles. No.
textes.Approchez ! Tout doit disparaître !: Step right up! Everything must go!
textes.Approchez, approchez ! Galettes d'algues: Step right up, step right up! Seaweed cakes! Fresh as can be! Well, fresh… wet. I'm Marée. And you are… dry! How exotic!
textes.Approchez, {surnom}. Plus près. Depuis c: Come closer, {surnom}. Closer. Since that splash when I was seventeen, I've never set foot on a boat again. Never. The mayor of a port! I open the new quays three metres from the edge, with a big smile and knees like jelly. The village across the water, I've only ever seen from here. Fernand suspects, I think. He's kind enough to say nothing.
textes.Approche… Barbe-Sanglante a déchiré sa c: Come closer… Barbe-Sanglante tore his map in three, so his men wouldn't betray each other. One piece sleeps in the dungeon of the Cursed Fort, to the east, guarded by his old sailors, the ones who are nothing but bones now. Another in the mausoleum of the graveyard, on the western hill. The third… Sylvain, at the Shark's Tooth, keeps it up his sleeve: he only bets it against someone who beats him three times in a row. Gather all three, take them to Philémon, the mapmaker. And may the sea keep you.
textes.Approche… plus près… Je vais te dire un: Come closer… closer… I'm going to tell you a secret, {surnom}. I can't swim. A fishery cat who can't swim! I look for the King from the jetty, never in the water. Grandpa thinks I'm sensible. I'm not sensible, I'm scared. I haven't told anyone, not even Grandpa. Especially not Grandpa.
textes.Après chaque plongée profonde, Lucie a m: After every deep dive, Lucie's ears hurt, and she doesn't tell anyone. So I keep a vial of warm oil for her by the stove. She comes by, takes it without a word, and leaves a shell in its place. I've got a drawer full of them.
textes.Après l'alliance perdue, j'ai raconté à: After the lost wedding ring, I told half the town that Léa didn't want to see her husband any more. She heard it from Rosalie, at the fish stall. So for a week, I folded the towels in room seven into heart shapes. On the fifth day, she left a note on the pillow: “Thanks for the hearts. Not a word.” I held out. Almost.
textes.Après l'hydromel, une bière au miel et a: After the honey drink, a fizz made with honey and ember mushroom, so good the king will sing in tune. Just once! It'd be a miracle, and I'd serve it free.
textes.Après la tempête, c'est elle qui a vu, d: After the storm, she was the one who saw, from the harbour master's office, that the beam was short. I was inside it, I couldn't see a thing. She ran up, all the way without stopping. She said nothing. She laid her hand on the cracked lens, like on a sick child's forehead.
textes.Après les plongées profondes, j'ai mal a: After deep dives, my ears hurt. I don't tell anyone. Anouk found out anyway, I don't know how. Since then, there's always a phial of warm oil in the corner by her stove, for me. I take it, I leave a shell. She must have a drawer full of them by now.
textes.Après les ressorts, j'ai boudé une semai: After the springs, I sulked for a week: not one paw in the forge. On the eighth evening I came back, all sheepish. She just said: “Hm. You're late.” She'd counted the evenings, {surnom}! That means she missed me. I think.
textes.Après les six sorts ? La cérémonie, au C: After the six spells? The ceremony, at the Moonstone Circle. You'll lay your hand on the altar, and the nine stones will decide. They've never said no. But first learn the six spells: light, fire, frost, levitation, telekinesis and healing.
textes.Après ma troisième deuxième place, Pépin: After my third second place, Pépin got out his brushes. Right at the bottom of the record board, he painted: “Grisou, almost first”. With a little arrow pointing up! I went to reread it every day for a week. My uncle came to see it too. He leaned in really close, for a really long time. He said “Hm”. He was proud, I think.
textes.Après mon premier été, je suis allé le v: After my first summer, I went to see him with two cones. I offered to go into business together: him the patter, me the ice cream. He looked at the cone, he looked at the sea, and he said: “Never.” Then he ate the whole cone, without stopping. A few days later, he opened Souvenirs d'Azur.
textes.Après sa troisième place de deuxième, Gr: After his third second place, Grisou had a face like a wet wolf. So I painted, right at the bottom of the record board, in neat little letters: “Grisou, almost first”. He came to read it again every day for a week, pointing it out to everyone. Even Bondi. Especially Bondi.
textes.Après tout le monde ?! À l'heure où je m: After everyone else?! By the time I get up, you've been asleep for… oh, I don't want to know. There'll only be crumbs left. And Mochi will have eaten them.
textes.Après un coup d'arme, garde le clic enfo: After a weapon blow, keep the button held: the blade charges up (it glows). Release: a terrible blow (×2.5). In VR: a very fast swing.
textes.Après une vingtaine d'années au long cou: After twenty-odd years on deep-sea voyages, I wanted to sleep in my own bed. Thirty years ago, I bought the Swallow, who was ten years old. Since then: six coats of paint, kings, newlyweds, a goat with no sea legs. My first month, a young man got off with his suitcase before we cast off. I gave him back his ticket. His name? That's for him to tell.
textes.Après ça, je dormirai sous un arbre pend: After that, I'll sleep under a tree for a year. At least. It's a fox technique.
textes.Après, il y a eu des jours affreux. Léa: After that came some awful days. Léa wasn't speaking to me. I bought a rose at Rose's: she didn't take it. I asked Inès for a ring “exactly the same”: she refused. Kiki lent me his punch ladle, I dug until midnight. In the evenings, at Paulo's, I looked at my finger and Léa looked at the sea. Ten days married, and already the longest week of my life.
textes.Après, je serai archiviste de la surface: After that, I'll be the archivist of the surface. Abyssos can look after down here, I'll do up there, and we'll share the ink.
textes.Après… je pourrai peut-être parler. Un p: After that… maybe I could talk. A little. To someone.
textes.Arbre marqué d'une entaille : il s'abat: Tree marked with a notch: chop it down with an axe
textes.Aristide t'envoie ? Alors le premier ver: Aristide sent you? Then the first drink is on me! Come back tonight, Django is playing.
textes.Aristide, c'est le maire. Le maire voleu: Aristide is the mayor. The thieving mayor. He won by one centimetre, measured by Marcel. I vote for him at every election, but only so he'll feel ashamed.
textes.Arrr ! … Non, je ne suis pas pirate. Je: Arrr! … No, I'm not a pirate. I'm practising.
textes.Arrête ! La violence n'a pas sa place so: Stop! Violence has no place beneath these branches.
textes.Arrête ! On ne frappe personne sous l'Ar: Stop! Nobody strikes anyone beneath the Mother Tree!
textes.Arrête ! Tu vas fâcher la Reine !: Stop! You'll make the Queen cross!
Stop slowing down when he walks in.
textes.Article 3 : la bonne humeur est interdit: Article 3: good cheer is prohibited after 6 p.m.
textes.As-tu écrit à ta moitié, là-bas ? Zéphyr: Have you written to your other half, over there? Zéphyr can carry letters. He shakes them about a bit, but they arrive.
textes.Asseyez-vous, {surnom}. Je ne suis pas e: Sit down, {surnom}. I'm not on holiday. The university has retired me. The letters Nadine brings me ask me to clear out my office. “Officially on holiday”: it's a lie I tell myself every morning. I've spent all my savings on charts and hotel nights. If I find nothing, I'll have nothing left. Not even the excuse.
textes.Assieds-toi, Morgane. La galette est cha: Sit down, Morgane. The crêpe is hot.
textes.Assieds-toi, assieds-toi. Je suis Tilleu: Sit down, sit down. I'm Tilleul, the storyteller. Want a story? Once upon a time… no, wait. Twice upon a time. It's a story that happened twice.
textes.Assieds-toi, ma petite. La galette non p: Sit down, little one. The crêpe doesn't have time either.
textes.Assieds-toi, petit, assieds-toi. Tu veux: Sit down, little one, sit down. Want a story? Of course you want a story. Everyone wants a story. I'm Corentin, and I know a thousand of them.
textes.Assieds-toi. Et parle moins fort, il y a: Sit down. And keep your voice down, people are eating.
Sit down. Moss, then a sweet.
textes.Assieds-toi. Quand je suis né, il n'y av: Sit down. When I was born, there was only one tree with folk living in it: the Mother Oak. My father, Frêne, had woven the wicker basket, and as a youngster I'd ride up in it to hear the old ones telling tales at the treetop. Later, I ran it myself. I talked so much that passengers took the stairs, until my son Bourru took it over. Meanwhile, the bridges had grown from tree to tree.
textes.Assieds-toi. Serre les dents. … Voilà. T: Sit down. Grit your teeth. … There. Three stitches, a little balm, and a sip of tonic (for me). You're good as new. Well, as good as second-hand.
textes.Assister à la Nuit des Aurores: Watch the Night of the Auroras
textes.Assister à la Nuit des Aurores (chaque n: Watch the Night of the Auroras (every night from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m., above Astralys: watch it from the Agora, or better still, from the Observatory)
textes.Astralys — l'île flottante des Lumens (i: Astralys — the floating island of the Lumens (here, even the pebbles shine)
textes.Astralys, l'île flottante des Lumens: Astralys, the floating island of the Lumens
textes.Astralys, la cité de cristal et de lumiè: Astralys, the city of crystal and light
textes.Astuce : dis les couleurs à voix haute p: Tip: say the colours out loud while they light up. “Blue, pink, yellow…” It sticks on its own!
textes.Atteindre l'île flottante et sa citadell: Reach the floating island and its citadel
textes.Atteindre la salle du trône, au 5e étage: Reach the throne room, on the 5th floor of the dungeon
textes.Attendre. C'est ce que je fais depuis ce: Waiting. That's what I've been doing for a hundred and eighty years, on the other side. You've got patience. That's… proper. Very proper.
textes.Attends la touche… (clic : remonter): Wait for the bite…  (click: reel in)
textes.Attention aux feux follets : quand ils b: Watch out for the will-o'-the-wisps: when they glow very bright, they charge. Step aside!
textes.Attention où tu marches : des pots de pe: Watch where you step: paint pots lie all over the place. Someone is repainting the house… in two colors.
textes.Attention où tu mets les pieds, il y a d: Watch where you put your feet, there's tar everywhere. Tobias. Caulker. I plug holes. In a ship a hundred and forty metres long, there's always a hole.
textes.Attention à la tête : un fauteuil passe: Watch your head: an armchair is drifting over you, quite calmly.
textes.Attention à la tête, le grand ! … Ah non: Mind your head, big one! … Oh no, you're the big one.
Be careful not to fall… upwards.
Mind your arms, the eggs are there.
textes.Attention, je ne m'arrête pas. Mes frein: Warning, I do not stop. Brakes are optional.
textes.Attention… le canard… il sait voler…: Watch out… the duck… it can fly…
textes.Au Bois-Doré, nos maisons sont posées da: In Bois-Doré, our houses sit in the branches of trees so tall their tops touch the clouds. You'll see. I promise you.
textes.Au Grand Troc de l'an dernier, la chaîne: At last year's Great Swap, the chain reaches us: Caramel holds out a sardine, I hold out my carrot bread. She sniffs, goes “Mrrr”, and refuses. So I refused the sardine. First broken chain in twenty years! Bedaine sat down on the ground. Meanwhile, Mochi and Myrtille had already swapped their snacks.

At last year's Great Swap, the chain reached the two of us. Trèfle holds out her carrot bread. I say: “Mrrr. No.” I hold out my sardine. She says: “Certainly not.” And the chain broke. The first time in twenty years. Bedaine sat down on the ground. He still sighs when he sees me.
textes.Au bord de la Marmite: At the edge of the Cauldron
textes.Au bord du cratère, il y a un aigle. Un: On the edge of the crater there's an eagle. A REAL eagle, as big as a house. The golems chained her up. She cries at night… My goats can't sleep anymore.
textes.Au bout du chemin noir, un coffre de boi: At the end of the black path, a painted wooden chest: red feathers and bones. Odd luggage for going down among the dead…
textes.Au carré ? Oh, je pourrais vous embrasse: Neat and square? Oh, I could kiss you! You're the guest every chambermaid dreams of. I'm reserving you a room in my guesthouse. The best one.
textes.Au cercle des contes, je répare mes file: At the storytelling circle, I mend my nets while Faelar tells his tales. One day he got a name wrong in a six-hundred-year-old story. I coughed, just once. He stopped, looked at me, and corrected himself. Since then, whenever he hesitates, he turns to me. I don't even need to look up.
textes.Au commencement, il n'y avait que la mer: In the beginning there was only the sea. A star fell, so tired that it fell asleep in the water. As it dreamed, it grew a seed… the Mother Tree. And we are its leaves.
textes.Au couronnement de Thorgal, Nori a regar: At Thorgal's coronation, Nori looked at my axe in front of the whole court and said, quietly but loud enough: “The third rune is upside down.” It was. The king kept the axe that way. He says it brings luck. Nori says it brings luck upside down.
textes.Au couronnement de Thorgal, la troisième: At Thorgal's coronation, the third rune on the axe Borin had forged was upside down. The right way up, it says “strength”. Upside down, it says “weariness”. I said so. Very quietly. But the Great Hall has a ready echo. Borin has never quite forgiven me. And the king is weary, in the mornings.
textes.Au couronnement, quand j'ai dit que la t: At the coronation, when I said the third rune was upside down, Borin turned red right up to his scalp. The next day, he came to my alcove with the axe and a chisel, and said: “Show me.” I showed him. He didn't fix the axe. But he has never carved a rune upside down again.
textes.Au cours de Yaya, je copie le chat. Il e: In Yaya's class, I copy the cat. He's really gifted, I promise: he lifts his paw right on the beat. One day Yaya told me: “Zoé, watch the cat, not me.” I watched the cat. The cat watched me. We did the crab step together. Yaya applauded. The cat left, offended.
textes.Au crépuscule, je monte l'escalier avec: At dusk I climb the stairs with Mister Hulotte, really slowly: one step, one question, one step, one question. One day I asked him if my papa was in the stars. He said he hadn't finished counting. So I gave a star a name, number four thousand two hundred and thirteen: Cerfeuil. He wrote it in his journal. I saw!
textes.Au crépuscule, on s'assoit sur mon banc: At dusk, we sit on my bench with a teapot, and Amélie has me taste her herbal teas. The thyme one, the rosemary one, the “broken heart” one, with my lavender. I tell her what's missing, she makes a note. Once, I told her: “A moonflower is missing.” She noted it down. We're waiting.
textes.Au crépuscule. J'apporte les tasses, toi: At dusk. I'll bring the cups, you bring the honey.
textes.Au fait, tu connais {qn}, maintenant. Al: By the way, you know {qn} now. So, what's your verdict?
textes.Au fait, vous connaissez {qn}, maintenan: By the way, you know {qn} now. So, what's your verdict?
textes.Au fond de l'armoire, dans une chaussett: At the back of the wardrobe, in a sock:
textes.Au fond de la baie, il y a des pierres t: At the bottom of the bay, there are cut stones covered in seaweed. Steps, maybe. They go down towards the open sea. Matthias wants me to draw them. Underwater. With a pencil.
textes.Au fond du coffre, gravé dans le bois :: At the bottom of the chest, engraved in the wood: “To the one who gave the Great Moai his eyes back, and the Hall of Song its voice. Thank you. — The Elders (and the little Moai, who helped carry).”
textes.Au fond du cul-de-sac, un coffre tout co: At the end of the dead end, a very sticky chest. Inside: a vial of sap, some coins… and a label: “Property of the slimes. Do not touch.” Too late.
textes.Au hibou ! Et tu t'es endormi au moment: At the owl! And you fell asleep when the wolf came in!
textes.Au large du village, on prend des daurad: Off the village, you catch sea bream this big. Paulo pays well for them for his bouillabaisse.
textes.Au marché, Marley et moi, on a un stand: At the market, Marley and I share one stall: necklaces on the left, bananas on the right. One day a lady bought three necklaces from me. Marley gave her a whole bunch, “because she looked like family”. She left with more bananas than necklaces. I did the maths: that day, we lost money.
textes.Au mariage de Marius et d'Odette, j'ai a: At Marius and Odette's wedding, I lit the lighthouse in broad daylight, at noon, for them. The old keeper gave me a right telling-off. Odette, on the church steps, looked up and laughed. I'd never seen her laugh. Marius said: “See? He talks with his lamp, my brother.”
textes.Au moins, c'est honnête. Tes traces le d: At least that's honest. Your tracks already said so: they hesitate at every bridge. Stay near the lanterns. And if you get lost, stay put. I'll find you.
textes.Au moins, elle n'a pas peur des étincell: At least it's not scared of sparks.
textes.Au nord de ton village, il y a un cercle: North of your village, there's a circle of standing stones. On my Ancients' map, there's a serpent drawn right in the middle. The ground sounds hollow there, {surnom}. A shovel would work wonders.
textes.Au nord, les ronces. Elles avancent d'un: To the north, the brambles. They advance one step every year. One day they'll eat the village. Nobody listens to me.
textes.Au pas ! Au pas, j'ai dit !: Walking pace! I said walking pace!
textes.Au pied du phare, sous une pierre qui lu: At the foot of the lighthouse, under a glowing stone: an iron box full of coins, and a note: “For the next one who sees it. — T.”
textes.Au prix de l'autre fois ? Non. L'autre f: At last time's price? No. Last time was a mistake.
textes.Au sommet des murailles de Dité, trois s: At the top of the walls of Dité, three figures spread their wings: the FURIES! “Nobody enters Dité!” they cry, diving at you.
